prerequisites.network: Required for first install of Python dependencies; not required after setup
prerequisites.ffmpeg: Optional for video posters and mock video
prerequisites.node: Not required when installing an official archive with prebuilt web assets

data_policy.update: Application versions are installed side by side
data_policy.rollback: The prior application version can be reactivated without changing data
data_policy.uninstall: Application files are removed; user data is preserved unless purge is explicit
